notes.title: 0.9 Demo Patch Notes and rebranding
notes.content:
Hello!
As some of you might have noticed we've recently changed the game name to Checkmate Kings. 
With it also comes a list of major updates to the demo!

⁃  Online Quick Play, Join Game, and Host!
You will now be able to play Online! Whether you want to find a quick match or play with friends, you can do it. Keep in mind we're still in development so bugs are expected.

⁃  The Kings' Gauntlet!
Challenge every character in the Kings' Gauntlet, play until you defeat them all or you lose.

⁃  New voiceovers and SFXs!
The announcer will now speak during the match to help convey crucial pieces of information.

⁃  Achievements!
Play to unlock multiple achievements. 

⁃ Main menu pieces updated!
Chess pieces will now change every time you visit the main menu.

⁃ QoL improvements, AI improvements, bug fixes, and more.

notes.title: 0.8.1 Demo Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello! Next weekend we're going to be in Kyoto, Japan, for the Bitsummit. What better occasion to add Japanese localization in the demo?

Here’s a list of the major changes:

 ⁃ Japanese localization!
The demo has been fully localized in Japanese.

 ⁃ Characters arenas!
George and Wukong now have their unique arenas.

⁃ Customizable boards!
We've added an option to play with classic, clear, or dark board. Choose your favourite!

 ⁃ QoL improvements, AI improvements, and bug fixes.

notes.title: 0.7.1 Demo Patch Notes
notes.content:
It's just been a week since our last update but we're back with more!

Here’s a list of the major changes:

 ⁃ Match timer and speed up mechanic!
We've already been humbled by how good some of you players are already!
Some matches even got over the 5-minute mark! 
While that can be very exciting we want to test the best of you even further. After a minute the pieces will start getting faster and faster, how long will you be able to dodge them now?

 ⁃ HUD!
We've updated the indicator over the characters to better show how many crowns you've gathered in your game. 
We've also added a bar to reflect the state of the board.

⁃ Audio and visual improvements!
We've made a few improvements to some of the visual elements and weapons SFXs

 ⁃ QoL improvements, AI improvements, and bug fixes.

notes.title: 0.7.0 Demo Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We've just released a new trailer and we gave a fresh coat of paint to the Steam page, do you like the new look?
Also the release date is getting closer and we're updating the demo as we go.

Here’s a list of the major changes:

 ⁃ Homing bullets and auto aim!
We want the focus of the game to be on the chess pieces and dodging so we've made it a little easier to hit your opponent regardless of what character you choose to play.

 ⁃ Game summary!
Once the game ends you'll now be able to see how the game went.
We've implemented a graph representing the flow of the match and a few stats.

 ⁃ Voicelines!
We've hired some great voice actors to give life to our character. As of now you can hear George and Wukong but the full roster will be dubbed.

 ⁃ UX improvements!
We've implemented a new system to let you know where a piece is coming from and where it's going with a glance, improving your ability to make quick choices.

 ⁃ Characters info!
You'll now be able to see how a character plays with the push of a button. 

⁃ Weapon visual improvements!
We've updated the look of the weapons to be more visible. 

 ⁃ QoL improvements and bug fixes.

notes.title: 0.6.0 Demo Patch Notes
notes.content:
We’ve been fairly quiet in the last few months but development on Kings Gauntlet: Chess Revolution has continued smoothly.
To keep everyone in the loop we’ve decided to update the demo with a fresh coat of paint and some extra features.
We’re also happy to announce that a new monarch has joined George in the chess revolution. You’ll now be able to play with one extra character!

Here’s a list of the major changes:

 ⁃ New character: Sun Wukong, the Monkey King. 
Fast attacks but short range, dominate your opponent in the race for the crown. 

 ⁃ UI rework.
Game mode selection screen.
Character selection screen.
Unique portraits for each character.

 ⁃ Checkmate cam.
New system implemented which lets you review the last few seconds before checkmate each game.

 ⁃ Visual improvements to the crown system and more.

 ⁃ QoL improvements and bug fixes.

notes.title: 0.5.0 Demo Patch Notes
notes.content:
Here’s a list of the major changes:
 ⁃ New Watch System: pieces now show their area of influence even when inactive.
 ⁃ Reworked main menu art. More to come!
- Implemented round system.
 ⁃ Added bloom on projectiles.
 ⁃ Auto fire enabled.
 ⁃ Piece placement changed from button input to button release.
 ⁃ AI improved in many ways. Easy and Medium difficulty are the most touched by the changes.
 ⁃ Ultimate area of influence buffed to double what it was before.
 ⁃ Many bug fixes and QoL improvements.
 ⁃ Added more locked WIP characters.
 ⁃ New avatar for the bot.
 ⁃ In a previous update we’ve also added a survey and some minor changes.

We hope you’ll check it out and let us know what you think!

notes.title: 👑👑👑 Steam Next Fest 👑👑👑
notes.content:
[h2]Join us on the 2nd and 6th of October!
[/h2]
We’re very excited to write our first post on the KG:CR Steam page for a very special occasion: you can now try the game out yourself!

As of today, you can download the first KG:CR [b]demo [/b]which will allow you to try out one of our staple characters, George. You will be able to play either [b]locally[/b], with a friend, or train your skills [b]against the computer[/b]! 
The full game will of course also have [b]online multiplayer[/b] and many more surprises but we’re still in the process of developing and optimizing many of the final features so you’ll have to wait to try those out. Not to worry though!
If you’d like to follow the development and start engaging with the developers and the KG:CR community all you have to do is join our new, shiny, [b][url=https://discord.gg/2gdfxs3QzQ]Discord server[/url][/b]!

We’re also very excited to announce that we will [b]play the game live[/b] on the [b]2nd[/b] and [b]6th[/b] of October at [b]12 AM PDT | 07 PM GMT[/b] and we’ll discuss the game inspirations, challenges, features to come and much more, so save the date and make sure not to miss it!
